subject: Security audit report request and CAIQ mapping for GRC portal upload
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security audit report (CAIQ) for GRC portal upload

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. As part of Acme's vendor assessment for our analytics product line, the GRC team requires a copy of your latest penetration test summary plus a CAIQ mapping that shows where the PT findings tie to CAIQ controls. The portal requires one consolidated PDF (redacted where necessary) and a separate spreadsheet mapping findings to CAIQ IDs.

Two questions for you:
- Can you confirm whether you can provide a redacted pen-test executive summary (no raw exploit PoC) that we can upload to the GRC?
- Do you have a CAIQ mapping spreadsheet we can attach, or should we expect the SIG/CAIQ on your portal?

Acme's deadline for the upload is EOD Wednesday (2027-05-05). If you need more time, tell us the ETA and we'll document it in the portal.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Information Security Manager, Acme Corporation

---
Attachment: assessment_requirements_acme.pdf (pdf)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:08:22 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: security audit report (CAIQ) for GRC portal upload

Team — forwarding Acme's request. TL;DR: they need a redacted pen-test executive summary + CAIQ mapping spreadsheet uploaded to their portal by Wed EOD.

Rishi: can you confirm what we can share from the 2027 internal/third-party engagement with Red Team Labs? I expect we'll need the executive summary redacted and a controls mapping. Please highlight any items that must remain internal (e.g., exploit detail, IP addresses, customer-specific artifacts).

Aditya: if Rishi confirms we can share, please prepare the CAIQ mapping spreadsheet and a short cover note for the portal upload (one paragraph describing redaction policy and data retention). Also, add a row in the remediation tracker for any outstanding findings called out to Acme.

Tessa: I may need you to coordinate with Acme's procurement side if they request an original unredacted report under an NDA. For now, let's aim to meet the portal upload requirement.

Thanks — Laura

---
Original message attached above

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 14:34:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: security audit report (CAIQ) for GRC portal upload

Laura / Aditya —

We completed the third-party engagement with Red Team Labs on 2027-04-18. I reviewed the final deliverable and confirm we can provide an executive summary with the following constraints:
- Redact proof-of-concept details, exploit scripts, internal IPs, and any customer-identified data.
- Leave high-level vulnerability descriptions, severity, impacted component, and remediation status.

I've exported a two-page executive summary and flagged items that require legal or product sign-off before sharing (one medium finding that mentions a deprecated internal endpoint). I've attached the redacted PDF draft and a remediation_status_tracker.csv with current statuses for all findings.

Action items:
- Aditya: please convert the findings list into CAIQ control mappings in the spreadsheet and add a brief note for each finding on whether the remediation is completed, in progress, or planned.
- Laura: confirm whether we should include the 'remediation ETA' column in the portal upload (Acme sometimes wants ETAs visible).

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_redacted_v2.pdf (draft), remediation_status_tracker.csv

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood_pen_test_redacted_v2.pdf (pdf); remediation_status_tracker.csv (csv)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:07:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: security audit report (CAIQ) for GRC portal upload

Laura / team —

I've built the CAIQ mapping spreadsheet (caiq_mapping_sheet_ACME_v1.xlsx). For each pen-test finding I mapped the associated CAIQ control IDs and included a short rationale. I also added columns: remediation_status (Completed/In Progress/Planned), remediation_owner, and remediation_eta (ISO date).

Notes:
- The medium finding R-13 references an internal deprecated endpoint; product confirmed mitigation plan and ETA 2027-05-28. We've marked remediation_status=In Progress and included ETA.
- Per Rishi's recommendation, I omitted any POC details.

I recommend we upload the following to Acme's portal: redwood_pen_test_redacted_v2.pdf (final), caiq_mapping_sheet_ACME_v1.xlsx, and a short portal_cover_note.txt that explains our redaction policy and retention window (I can draft that if you want).

Let me know if you want me to push the files into the portal (I have credentials for acme's upload flow).

Thanks,
Aditya
Compliance Analyst, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: caiq_mapping_sheet_ACME_v1.xlsx

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, Maya Ellis <maya.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security audit report (CAIQ) for GRC portal upload

Hi Liam / Maya —

Thanks for the reminder and patience. Attached are the materials Acme requested for the GRC portal upload:
- redwood_pen_test_redacted_v2.pdf (executive summary; POC and internal IPs redacted)
- caiq_mapping_sheet_ACME_v1.xlsx (mapping of pen-test findings to CAIQ controls)
- remediation_status_tracker.csv (current statuses and ETAs)

We have also uploaded the files to the portal on your behalf under record ACME-4891: https://grc.acme.com/upload/record/ACME-4891 (please confirm you can access). Our portal cover note was included describing redaction policy (summary: redactions remove POC/exploit details and customer-identifying data; retention: 12 months).

A couple clarifications:
- The medium finding R-13 is marked In Progress with ETA 2027-05-28. If you need an interim mitigation write-up, Rishi can provide a short technical note.
- If Acme requires an unredacted full report under a mutual NDA, please let us know procurement contact and we can route to Legal.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through the mapping.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redwood_pen_test_redacted_v2.pdf; caiq_mapping_sheet_ACME_v1.xlsx; remediation_status_tracker.csv
